en-US.title: Artemis Mission Tracker
en-US.shortDescription: Track NASA's Artemis II and III Moon missions: live timelines, crew, vehicles.
en-US.fullDescription:
Artemis Mission Tracker is your front-row seat to humanity's return to the Moon.

Follow NASA's Artemis II and Artemis III missions in one focused app — from launch countdown through lunar operations. Built for space enthusiasts who want signal, not noise.

WHAT YOU GET

Live mission timelines
Step-by-step timelines for Artemis II's lunar flyby and Artemis III's low Earth orbit docking rehearsal with the Starship HLS Pathfinder and Blue Moon Mk2 Pathfinder. See where each mission stands right now, what comes next, and when.

Crew profiles
Meet the astronauts flying Artemis II — Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen — and the announced Artemis III crew: Randy Bresnik, Luca Parmitano, Frank Rubio, and Andre Douglas.

Vehicle deep-dives
Detailed cards for every key piece of hardware: SLS Block 1, the Orion spacecraft, SpaceX's Starship Human Landing System, Blue Moon Mk2, and the AxEMU lunar spacesuit. Real NASA imagery, real specs.

Launch countdown
A precise countdown to the next major Artemis milestone, synced to NASA's latest schedule.

Mission alerts
Optional push notifications and in-app banners for launch windows, crew announcements, and major mission milestones. You choose what you want to hear about.

Clean, focused design
No ads. No clutter. Dark space-themed interface that respects your attention.

ARTEMIS+ (PREMIUM)
Go premium to unlock the Artemis Briefing — Wednesday deep-dives and a short Sunday Week Ahead, plus member-only mission notes inside the app. Sober editorial coverage, no clickbait. Monthly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime.

WHY ARTEMIS

NASA's Artemis program is the most ambitious crewed spaceflight effort since Apollo. In April 2026, Artemis II flew four astronauts around the Moon, the first crewed lunar mission in over fifty years. The first crewed lunar landing has moved to Artemis IV, with Artemis III now flying a critical docking rehearsal in low Earth orbit.

Artemis Mission Tracker keeps you informed without overwhelming you. Built by a developer who watches every launch.

SOURCES

Mission data and timelines are sourced from NASA's official mission pages, SpaceX press materials, Blue Origin announcements, and reputable space journalism. All imagery is properly attributed in-app.

ABOUT

Made in Norway by Orbital Momentum AS. Independent. No ads.

Questions or feedback? Reach out from inside the app or at artemis-briefing.kit.com
